activities.title: Build or refresh Ohm's law and series-circuit model
activities.purpose: Establish the minimum conceptual and procedural model needed to solve a simple series circuit using Ohm's law.
activities.instructions: Recall or read the statement of Ohm's law: V = IR. Draw one simple series circuit with a voltage source and one or more resistors. Label voltage, current, and resistance. Work one example: given V and total R, compute current; if two resistors are in series, compute total resistance as R1 + R2 and then current. Explain in your own words why current is the same through all series components and how voltage drops across resistors relate to the total voltage. Check units and correct any errors before moving on.
activities.stoppingCondition: Move to the independent changed-circuit check once you can compute and explain the given circuit correctly; if not, correct errors once and proceed rather than adding unlimited practice.
activities.completionCriterion: Correctly compute and explain one simple series circuit with given voltage and resistance, showing V = IR, series current rule, total resistance addition when applicable, and unit consistency; correct any errors.

activities.title: Independent changed-circuit solve and explanation
activities.purpose: Verify independent readiness on a changed simple series circuit, matching the user's stated stop condition.
activities.instructions: Choose or create a changed version of the circuit that you did not solve in the previous activity: change the voltage value and/or resistance values, and use two resistors in series if helpful. Without looking at notes, solve for total resistance, current, and voltage across each resistor. Then explain in your own words: how you used V = IR, why current is the same through series elements, and how the voltage drops add to the total source voltage. Check your result with an independent calculation or a second method.
activities.stoppingCondition: Stop once you have independently solved and explained the changed circuit correctly; no additional problems are required.
activities.completionCriterion: Independently solve and explain a changed simple series circuit correctly (total resistance, current, voltage drops) without notes, and justify each step using V = IR and series rules.
